title: Theory of Quantum Imaginary-Time Mpemba Effect
summary: Quantum imaginary-time evolution (QITE) is a fundamental framework for preparing ground and thermal states, yet its computational cost scales significantly with the evolution duration $τ$. Reducing this duration is critical for practical quantum advantage. Here, we establish a unified theoretical framework for the Mpemba effect in QITE -- a counterintuitive phenomenon where a state initially farther from the ground state relaxes to it faster than one initially closer.
